ST7701 vendor command data adapted from 78/xiaozhi-esp32@49b4380b3faa0ceadd28a3e78aaf0f311c46c57e, main/boards/waveshare/esp32-s3-touch-lcd-4b/esp32-s3-touch-lcd-4b.cc. All35 commands/payloads/order/delays retained in fixed-size C++ data. Upstream MIT terms retained in LICENSE; no entire board class copied and no project-wide license change. Local controller lifecycle uses installed3wireIO, explicit SWRESET120ms/bank00/MADCTL00/COLMOD60 preamble matching reviewed ST7701 2.0.2~2 driver, then vendor COLMOD66, always deleting initialization IO before RGB/LVGL registration.
